android.desc:
💸 Masareef is a fast, private expense tracker and budget planner that does the boring part for you.

Most money manager apps make you type in every purchase, and after a week you stop. Masareef reads your bank's SMS and payment alerts on your device and turns them into transactions by itself, even while the app is closed.

⚡ AUTOMATIC SPENDING CAPTURE

• Card payments, transfers, top-ups, ATM withdrawals and income, each to the right wallet
• Add a card's last 4 digits to route its alerts to its wallet
• Free includes 25 automatic captures a month; Masareef Pro lifts the cap
• Review a capture in one tap, or let confident ones post automatically, with undo
• Auto-tracking stays off until you turn it on

🏦 WORKS WITH YOUR BANK

Reads alerts from 1202 banks, wallets & payment apps:

• Egypt — NBE, Banque Misr, CIB, QNB Alahli, Banque du Caire, AAIB, Bank of Alexandria, HSBC, Crédit Agricole, ADIB, Al Baraka, HDB, SAIB, FABMISR, Arab Bank, aiBANK
• Egypt wallets — InstaPay, Vodafone Cash, Orange Cash, e& Cash, WE Pay, Fawry, Telda, ValU, Meeza, MNT-Halan, Money Fellows, Khazna, OPay
• Saudi Arabia — Al Rajhi, SNB, Riyad Bank, SAB, Alinma, Albilad, ANB, Banque Saudi Fransi, Bank Aljazira, stc pay, urpay, mada Pay, Tabby, Tamara
• Gulf & MENA — Emirates NBD, FAB, ADCB, Mashreq, Dubai Islamic Bank, RAKBANK, NBK, KFH, QNB
• Maghreb — BaridiMob, BNA, CPA, BADR, Attijariwafa, CIH, Banque Populaire, Bank of Africa, BIAT, Flouci
• Asia — HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Paytm, HBL, JazzCash, bKash, Maybank, GCash
• Africa — GTBank, Zenith, Kuda, Moniepoint, M-PESA, FNB
• Europe & Americas — Revolut, Wise, Monzo, Barclays, Chase, Citi, Nubank

Independent: not affiliated with any bank or wallet listed, and never asks for your banking password.

⌨️ ADD IN SECONDS

• Say or type it, in Arabic or English: "spent 250 coffee" posts instantly
• A home screen widget and a Quick Settings tile add a spend without opening it
• Or reply straight from the notification

👛 WALLETS & MULTI-CURRENCY

• Cash, bank accounts and mobile wallets side by side, each with a balance
• Pick any country and currency; symbols, formatting and bank list follow

🎯 BUDGETS & PLANNING

• Per-category budgets with on-track, near-limit and over states
• A monthly target that says what's safe to spend today
• Cash flow shows whether your balance lasts to payday

🕌 ZAKAT & DEBTS

• Zakat from the wealth you track, against nisab, at today's gold price
• Money you owe and ar
